title: Dashboard item
description: One piece of work on the dashboard. A superset of the Atlas BacklogItem (lekman/atlas packages/core/src/model.ts): every Atlas field keeps its name and meaning, so an Atlas item copies across unchanged. Priority is computed on read from businessValue, effort and due; the stored priority is only the fallback until both businessValue and effort are set. The today/tomorrow/future band is computed from scheduledFor and never stored.

id.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens (Atlas Identifier). New items use a lower-case ULID; imported items keep their id. Never reused.

classification.description: How sensitive the item is. Atlas reads it before anything moves between places.

boundary.description: Where the item is allowed to live (Atlas boundary).

workstreamId.description: The workstream it is grouped under. Absent means unsorted.

summary.description: The current state in plain language. Skills keep it to about 550 characters; the hard limit is higher so imported dashboard prose fits. History lives in log.

priority.description: As imported, or as set by hand. Only used until businessValue and effort are both set; from then on priority is computed.

tracker.description: Where the item is tracked outside. The key is the item's identity when it has one; never invented.

businessValue.description: How much the work is worth: negative (-1) means doing it costs more than it returns; none (0) to veryHigh (4) rise from there. Low or below is always low priority. Atlas's Fibonacci value (1-13) maps to this on import.

due.description: A real, externally fixed deadline. Urgency is computed from it; it is not a way to express urgency.

scheduledFor.description: The day it is planned for. Absent means unscheduled.

rank.description: Manual tie-break within a day, a sortable string (a0, a5, b). Priority orders first; rank only orders items that tie on everything else.

blocked.description: Waiting on someone else (the dashboard's construction-sign marker).

blockedOn.description: Who or what it waits for. Only allowed when blocked is true; recommended then, but optional so imported items without details stay valid.

doneOn.description: The day it was ticked off.

kind.description: admin marks quick administrative jobs that are cleared ahead of project work.

detailsId.description: The details document that explains it.

history.description: What happened to the item itself, oldest first. Atlas writes kind added or moved with on and from; the other kinds and fields are additions. Append only.

log.description: Progress notes, oldest first: a time and a short status. Append only.

claim.description: The agent that has started this item, so another does not start it too. claim.by is the Atlas Agent id (or a person); an agent's Atlas workingOn list is the items it claims, most recent claim first.

pullRequests.description: The item's own pull requests, as owner/repo#number, set by the agent that opens them. Readers show only these when the list is set.

revision.description: Increments on every write. A write names the revision it read; a mismatch means someone wrote first, and the write is refused instead of overwriting.

state.description: review: a pull request waits for review. approved: approved, not merged. merged: merged, not yet released. done: released, or finished for work that is never released.

actor.description: Who did it: a person (tobias) or an agent session (claude:web-static).
